question: Where does Moses speak these words to all Israel?
choices: On this side Jordan in the wilderness
explanation: Deuteronomy opens with Moses speaking to Israel east of the Jordan.

question: How many days' journey is it from Horeb to Kadesh-barnea by Mount Seir?
explanation: Moses notes that the trip from Horeb to Kadesh-barnea was eleven days.

question: Why did Moses say he could not bear Israel by himself?
choices: They were too numerous and burdensome for one man
explanation: Moses recalled needing leaders because the people were too many for him alone.

question: What did the spies bring back from the land?
explanation: The spies brought fruit from the land to show it was good.

question: Why did that generation fail to enter the promised land?
choices: They rebelled and did not believe the Lord
explanation: Moses reminds them that unbelief and rebellion kept that generation out.

question: Who spoke these words to all Israel?
explanation: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan.

question: In which year did Moses speak to the children of Israel?
explanation: It came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, that Moses spake unto the children of Israel.

question: How many men were chosen to search out the land?
explanation: I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe.

question: At which mountain did the LORD tell Israel they had dwelt long enough?
explanation: The LORD our God spake unto us in Horeb: Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount.

question: Who was promised he would see the land because he wholly followed the LORD?
explanation: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, because he hath wholly followed the LORD.

question: Who was told he would not go into the land for the people's sake?
explanation: The LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither.

question: Which three fathers had the LORD sworn to give the land?
explanation: The land which the LORD sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

question: What guided Israel by day?
explanation: The LORD went before you to shew you the way, in fire by night and in a cloud by day.

question: Which group, said to be a prey, would be given the land?
explanation: Your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it.

question: Who chased Israel like bees when they went up into the hill?
explanation: The Amorites came out against you, and chased you, as bees do.

question: Which king of the Amorites, dwelling in Heshbon, had Moses slain?
explanation: He had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon.

question: Og, whom Moses had slain, was king of what?
explanation: He had slain Og the king of Bashan.

question: In which land did Moses begin to declare this law?
explanation: On this side Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law.

question: Which great river was named as the edge of the land?
explanation: Unto Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates.

question: What kind of men did Moses tell them to take as rulers?
choices: Wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes
explanation: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.

question: Moses made captains over thousands, hundreds, tens and what?
explanation: Captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens.

question: How were the judges told to judge?
explanation: Judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.

question: To whom were hard cases to be brought?
explanation: The cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.

question: Which valley did the spies reach?
explanation: They came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.

question: What report did the spies bring about the land?
explanation: They said, It is a good land which the LORD our God doth give us.

question: Why did Israel murmur in their tents?
choices: They said the LORD hated them
explanation: Because the LORD hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt.

question: Who did Israel say had discouraged their heart?
explanation: Our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people is greater and taller than we.

question: Whose sons did the people say they had seen there?
explanation: We have seen the sons of the Anakims there.

question: What did Moses say to calm the people's fear?
choices: Dread not, neither be afraid of them
explanation: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.

question: Why did the LORD say He would not let Israel's evil generation see the land?
choices: He heard their words and was wroth
explanation: The LORD heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware.

question: To which place did Israel come after leaving Horeb?
explanation: We departed from Horeb and we came to Kadesh-barnea.

question: How did Moses describe the wilderness they crossed?
explanation: We went through all that great and terrible wilderness.

question: Why would Caleb receive the land he had trodden upon?
explanation: To him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, because he hath wholly followed the LORD.

question: The plain where Moses spoke was over against which sea?
explanation: In the plain over against the Red sea, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.

question: The Amorites destroyed Israel in Seir, even to where?
explanation: The Amorites chased you and destroyed you in Seir, even unto Hormah.

question: In which month did Moses speak to Israel?
explanation: In the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month.

question: At which place did Og dwell?
explanation: Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei.

question: How long did Israel stay at Kadesh?
explanation: Ye abode in Kadesh many days.

question: What did Israel say they would do after the LORD's sentence?
explanation: We have sinned against the LORD, we will go up and fight.

question: Why did the LORD say Israel should not go up and fight?
explanation: Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten.

question: What did the LORD do when Israel returned and wept?
choices: He would not hearken to their voice
explanation: The LORD would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.

question: How did the LORD bear Israel in the wilderness?
choices: As a man doth bear his son
As a king guards a gate
explanation: The LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son.

question: What had each man done before going up into the hill?
choices: Girded on his weapons of war
explanation: Ye had girded on every man his weapons of war, ye were ready to go up into the hill.

question: By which way were they told to turn into the wilderness?
choices: By the way of the Red sea
explanation: Turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

question: Which man was Moses told to encourage because he would cause Israel to inherit?
explanation: Joshua the son of Nun, which standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage him.

question: Around what mountain did Israel compass many days?
explanation: Israel wandered around Mount Seir many days.

question: Which relatives of Israel were not to be troubled because God had given them land?
explanation: Israel was not to trouble the children of Esau in Seir, or Moab and Ammon, the children of Lot, because God had given them their lands.

question: What king of Heshbon came out against Israel and was defeated?
explanation: Sihon king of Heshbon resisted Israel and was defeated.

question: What did God say He would begin to put upon the nations that day?
choices: The dread and fear of thee
explanation: God said, "This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations."

question: What happened to the generation of warriors that came out of Egypt?
choices: They were consumed from among the host
explanation: The men of war from that generation were consumed in the wilderness.

question: Which people dwelt in Mount Seir?
explanation: Ye are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir.

question: Which direction did the LORD tell Israel to turn?
explanation: Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.

question: What was Israel to buy from the children of Esau?
explanation: Ye shall buy meat of them for money, and water of them for money.

question: Which brook did Israel cross?
explanation: Get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.

question: How many years from Kadesh-barnea until crossing the brook Zered?
explanation: The space from Kadesh-barnea until we were come over the brook Zered was thirty and eight years.

question: Whom did Moses send messengers to?
explanation: I sent messengers unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace.

question: What kind of words did the messengers carry?
explanation: I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon with words of peace.

question: What did Sihon do when asked to let Israel pass?
choices: He would not let them pass
explanation: Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him.

question: Where did Sihon and his people fight Israel?
explanation: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.

question: Who delivered Sihon before Israel?
explanation: The LORD our God delivered him before us; and we smote him.

question: To whom had the LORD given Mount Seir?
explanation: I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.

question: How much of Esau's land would the LORD give Israel?
choices: Not so much as a footbreadth
explanation: I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a footbreadth.

question: Who received Ar as a possession?
explanation: I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession.

question: What did the Moabites call the tall people who once dwelt in their land?
explanation: They were accounted giants, but the Moabites call them Emims.

question: What did the Ammonites call the giants of their land?
explanation: The Ammonites call them Zamzummims.

question: Who dwelt in Seir beforetime and were destroyed by Esau's children?
explanation: The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them.

question: How did Moses say the LORD had cared for Israel for forty years?
explanation: These forty years the LORD thy God hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.

question: Which river did the LORD tell Israel to pass over before Sihon?
explanation: Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon.

question: From which wilderness did Moses send messengers?
explanation: I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth.

question: What did Israel ask Sihon to allow?
explanation: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the high way.

question: Why would Sihon not let Israel pass?
explanation: The LORD thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate.

question: What did Israel take for a prey from Sihon's cities?
explanation: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, and the spoil of the cities.

question: From Aroer, Israel found no city too strong unto where?
explanation: From Aroer even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us.

question: Which land did Israel not come to, as the LORD forbade?
choices: The land of the children of Ammon
explanation: Only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not.

question: When did the LORD tell Moses to pass through Ar?
choices: After all the men of war were dead
explanation: When all the men of war were consumed and dead, the LORD spake unto me.

question: Why were the men of war consumed from the host?
choices: The hand of the LORD was against them
explanation: The hand of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from among the host.

question: Who destroyed the Avims who dwelt in Hazerim?
explanation: The Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them.

question: From which land did the Caphtorims come?
explanation: The Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them.

question: Israel passed by the way of the plain from Elath and from which place?
explanation: We passed by the way of the plain from Elath, and from Ezion-gaber.

question: How would the children of Esau feel toward Israel?
explanation: They shall be afraid of you: take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore.

question: How did Israel promise to pass through Sihon's land?
explanation: Only I will pass through on my feet.

question: What did Israel promise not to do on the high way?
explanation: I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.

question: Which peoples had sold Israel meat and water for money?
explanation: The children of Esau and the Moabites did unto me.

question: What did Israel do to the men, women and little ones of every city of Sihon?
explanation: We utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city.

question: The Emims were great, many and tall, like whom?
explanation: A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims.

question: What was Israel told not to do to the Moabites?
choices: Distress them or contend with them in battle
explanation: Distress not the Moabites, neither contend with them in battle.

question: Where did the Avims dwell before the Caphtorims destroyed them?
explanation: The Avims dwelt in Hazerim, even unto Azzah, until the Caphtorims destroyed them.

question: Which river did the LORD say Israel had not come near in Ammon's land?
explanation: Nor unto any place of the river Jabbok.

question: Israel was to pass through which place, the coast of Moab?
explanation: Thou art to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab, this day.

question: How was the land of Ammon also accounted in old time?
explanation: That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time.

question: What king of Bashan came out against Israel at Edrei?
explanation: Og king of Bashan came out to battle at Edrei.

question: How does Moses describe the cities of Og's kingdom that Israel took?
choices: Fenced with high walls, gates, and bars
explanation: The cities of Bashan were strongly fortified.

question: To which tribes was the land east of Jordan given?
explanation: Moses recalls giving this land to Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh.

question: Whom did Moses encourage with the reminder that the Lord would fight for Israel?
explanation: Moses charged Joshua not to fear because the Lord would fight for them.

question: From what mountain did Moses view the land he would not enter?
explanation: God told Moses to go up into Pisgah and behold the land.

question: What did the LORD tell Moses to do about Og?
explanation: The LORD said unto me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him into thy hand.

question: How many cities did Israel take from Og in Bashan?
explanation: There was not a city which we took not from them, threescore cities, all the region of Argob.

question: What happened to Og and his people?
choices: They were smitten until none was left
explanation: The LORD delivered Og into our hands: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.

question: Which region held the sixty cities of Og's kingdom?
explanation: Threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

question: Of what was Og's bedstead made?
explanation: His bedstead was a bedstead of iron.

question: Who alone remained of the remnant of giants?
explanation: Only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants.

question: Who took the country of Argob and named it after himself?
explanation: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob.

question: What did Israel take for a prey from Og's cities?
explanation: All the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.

question: What did Moses ask the LORD to let him do?
choices: Go over and see the good land
explanation: I pray thee, let me go over, and see the good land that is beyond Jordan.

question: Where did Israel abide at the end of the chapter?
choices: In the valley over against Beth-peor
explanation: So we abode in the valley over against Beth-peor.

question: The land taken from the two kings ran from Arnon unto which mount?
explanation: The land from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon.

question: What do the Sidonians call Hermon?
explanation: Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion.

question: What do the Amorites call Hermon?
explanation: The Amorites call it Shenir.

question: How long was Og's bedstead?
explanation: Nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it.

question: Where was Og's iron bedstead to be found?
choices: In Rabbath of the children of Ammon
explanation: Is it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon?

question: Which tribes received the land from Aroer and half mount Gilead?
explanation: From Aroer, and half mount Gilead, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites.

question: Who received the rest of Gilead and all Bashan?
explanation: The rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh.

question: What was Bashan called?
explanation: All the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.

question: What name did Jair give the villages he took?
explanation: He called them after his own name, Bashan-havoth-jair, unto this day.

question: Who was to pass over armed before their brethren?
choices: All that are meet for the war
explanation: Ye shall pass over armed before your brethren, all that are meet for the war.

question: Who were to stay in the cities Moses had given?
explanation: Your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, shall abide in your cities.

question: Until when were the warriors to stay with their brethren?
choices: Until the LORD gave rest to their brethren
explanation: Until the LORD have given rest unto your brethren, as well as unto you.

question: What did Moses call the mountain he longed to see beyond Jordan?
explanation: Let me go over, and see that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.

question: What did the LORD say when Moses begged to cross?
choices: Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter
explanation: The LORD said unto me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter.

question: How many directions was Moses to look from the top of Pisgah?
explanation: Lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward.

question: How wide was Og's iron bedstead?
explanation: Nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it.

question: Og's cities stretched unto Salchah and which other city?
explanation: Unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

question: Jair took Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and which other?
explanation: Jair took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi.

question: The plain and Jordan ran from Chinnereth to which sea?
explanation: From Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea.

question: Which river was the border of the children of Ammon?
explanation: The border even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon.

question: Beside the walled cities, what else did Israel take?
explanation: All these cities were fenced with high walls, gates, and bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.

question: Which king was Og to be treated like?
explanation: Thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites.

question: To whom was Gilead given in the chapter by name?
explanation: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.

question: What did Moses say the LORD had begun to show him?
choices: Thy greatness and thy mighty hand
explanation: Thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness, and thy mighty hand.

question: Why was the LORD wroth with Moses?
explanation: The LORD was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not hear me.

question: How many kings had Joshua's eyes seen the LORD deal with?
explanation: Thine eyes have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto these two kings.

question: What was Joshua told to do besides encourage him?
explanation: Charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him.

question: The bedstead's length was measured after what kind of cubit?
explanation: After the cubit of a man.

question: Which direction was named first when Moses lifted up his eyes?
explanation: Lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward.

question: The Reubenites and Gadites also received half of what, from Gilead to Arnon?
explanation: Unto the Reubenites and the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley.

question: What did Moses say Israel must not do to God's word?
choices: Add unto it or diminish from it
explanation: They were forbidden to add to or take away from God's commandments.

question: What did Moses say the nations would notice about Israel's law?
explanation: The nations would see Israel's wisdom in obeying God's statutes.

question: What image or form did Israel see when the Lord spoke from the fire at Horeb?
explanation: Israel saw no form when God spoke, which is part of the warning against idols.

question: What did Moses warn would happen if Israel made graven images and corrupted themselves?
choices: They would be scattered among the nations
explanation: Moses warned that idolatry would bring scattering among the nations.

question: What three cities did Moses set apart on this side Jordan?
explanation: Moses set apart Bezer, Ramoth, and Golan as cities of refuge east of Jordan.

question: What does Moses call the LORD your God?
explanation: The LORD thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.

question: Out of what did the LORD speak to Israel at Horeb?
explanation: The LORD spake unto you out of the midst of the fire.

question: How many commandments did the LORD declare as His covenant?
explanation: He declared unto you his covenant, even ten commandments.

question: What did the LORD write the commandments on?
explanation: He wrote them upon two tables of stone.

question: What does Moses call Egypt?
explanation: The LORD hath brought you forth out of the iron furnace, even out of Egypt.

question: Who was told he would not go over Jordan?
explanation: The LORD sware that I should not go over Jordan; I must die in this land.

question: At which mountain did the people stand and hear the LORD?
explanation: The day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb.

question: Which heavenly lights might tempt Israel to worship them?
explanation: When thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, shouldest be driven to worship them.

question: What will happen if Israel seeks the LORD with all their heart and soul?
explanation: If thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul, thou shalt find him.

question: What kind of God is the LORD, according to Moses?
explanation: The LORD thy God is a merciful God; he will not forsake thee.

question: What did the LORD do to the men who followed Baal-peor?
explanation: All the men that followed Baal-peor, the LORD thy God hath destroyed them from among you.

question: Who were alive every one that day?
choices: Those who cleaved unto the LORD
explanation: Ye that did cleave unto the LORD your God are alive every one of you this day.

question: Whom were Israel to teach the things they had seen?
explanation: Teach them thy sons, and thy sons' sons.

question: Why did the LORD gather the people at Horeb?
choices: So they might learn to fear Him
explanation: Gather me the people together, that they may learn to fear me.

question: How did Israel receive the LORD's words at Horeb?
choices: They heard a voice but saw no similitude
explanation: Ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice.

question: Why was Moses not allowed to enter the land?
choices: The LORD was angry with him for their sakes
explanation: The LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan.

question: Where did Moses say he must die?
explanation: I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan.

question: Whom did Moses call to witness against Israel if they sinned?
explanation: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day.

question: What kind of gods would Israel serve among the nations?
explanation: There ye shall serve gods, the work of men's hands, wood and stone.

question: How many would be left among the heathen?
explanation: Ye shall be left few in number among the heathen.

question: Which tribe received Bezer?
explanation: Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites.

question: Which tribe received Ramoth in Gilead?
explanation: Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites.

question: Which tribe received Golan in Bashan?
explanation: Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.

question: Why did Moses set apart the three cities?
choices: For the slayer who killed unawares
explanation: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares.

question: In which days would Israel turn to the LORD in tribulation?
choices: In the days of the judges
explanation: When thou art in tribulation, even in the latter days, if thou turn to the LORD thy God.

question: Which king dwelt at Heshbon in the land of the valley over against Beth-peor?
explanation: In the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon.

question: The land stretched from Aroer by Arnon to which mount?
explanation: From Aroer, which is by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which is Hermon.

question: The plain eastward reached under the springs of which mountain?
explanation: Even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.

question: Why did the LORD choose the seed of Israel's fathers?
explanation: Because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them.

question: The nations the LORD would drive out were greater and what?
explanation: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art.

question: Which water creature is named among forbidden likenesses?
explanation: The likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth.

question: Who divided the sun, moon and stars unto all nations?
explanation: The host of heaven, which the LORD thy God hath divided unto all nations.

question: What did Moses call Israel in relation to God?
explanation: To be unto him a people of inheritance, as ye are this day.

question: Which of these did God use to take a nation from another nation?
explanation: By a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors.

question: What did Moses ask if any people had heard God from the fire and lived?
choices: Did ever people hear and live?
explanation: Did ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, and live?

question: If Israel kept the statutes, what would be prolonged?
explanation: That thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth.

question: The mountain at Horeb burned with fire with what else?
explanation: The mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.

question: What did the nations say the great nation of Israel was?
explanation: Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.

question: What will the LORD not forget, though Israel is scattered?
explanation: He will not forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.

question: Where were the three cities set apart in relation to Jordan?
choices: On this side Jordan toward the sunrising
explanation: Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising.

question: With whom does Moses say the Lord made the covenant at Horeb?
choices: With us, even us, who are all alive this day
explanation: Moses emphasizes the covenant's relevance to the present generation.

question: How did all Israel hear the Ten Commandments at the mount?
choices: Through a dream in the night
By the Lord's voice out of the midst of the fire
explanation: The Lord spoke these words to all the assembly out of the midst of the fire with a great voice.

question: What reason is given here for keeping the Sabbath day?
explanation: Deuteronomy ties Sabbath observance to Israel's redemption from Egypt.

question: What did the people ask Moses to do after hearing God's voice?
explanation: The people asked Moses to hear God's words and then speak them to Israel.

question: What did God wish for the people after they promised to hear and do His words?
choices: That they would build Him a house
That they would go back to Egypt
That they would ask for a king
That they had a heart to fear Him and keep His commandments always
explanation: God said, "O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always."

question: Who stood between the LORD and the people to show them the word of the LORD?
explanation: Moses stood between the LORD and the people to show them the word of the LORD, for they were afraid of the fire.

question: What does the LORD call Egypt when He says He brought Israel out of it?
explanation: The LORD says He brought them out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

question: What did the LORD write the words on and give to Moses?
explanation: He wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto Moses.

question: What may Israel not make, according to the second commandment?
explanation: Thou shalt not make thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing.

question: Whom does the LORD tell Israel to honour?
explanation: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee.

question: Which of these is one of the commandments the LORD spoke?
choices: Thou shalt not move a landmark
Thou shalt not curse the deaf
explanation: The LORD said, Neither shalt thou steal.

question: What did the people say the LORD had shewed them at the mount?
explanation: They said, the LORD our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness.

question: Which day does the LORD call the sabbath of the LORD thy God?
explanation: The seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God.

question: What did the LORD tell Moses to say to the people when they went back from the mount?
choices: Get you into your tents again
explanation: The LORD said, Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.

question: The LORD says, 'Thou shalt have none other what before me'?
explanation: Thou shalt have none other gods before me.

question: Why did the people not go up into the mount?
choices: Moses forbade them with a rod
The path was blocked by water
They were afraid because of the fire
explanation: Moses says they were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount.

question: How does the LORD describe Himself when He forbids bowing to images?
explanation: For I the LORD thy God am a jealous God.

question: Mercy is promised to thousands of those who do what?

explanation: He shows mercy unto thousands of them that love him and keep his commandments.

question: What does the LORD say about the one who takes His name in vain?
choices: He will make him a servant
He will cut off his sons
He will not hold him guiltless
He will send him out of the camp
explanation: The LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

question: Why must a master give his manservant and maidservant rest on the sabbath?
choices: That they may rest as well as he
So they can guard the camp
explanation: The commandment says that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou.

question: What is promised to those who honour their father and mother?
explanation: Honour thy father and thy mother, that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee.

question: Which animals are named among those that must rest on the sabbath?
explanation: The sabbath rest covers thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle.

question: Who came near to Moses when the mountain burned with fire?
choices: The heads of the tribes and the elders
explanation: All the heads of your tribes, and your elders, came near unto Moses.

question: What did the people say no one had done and lived?
choices: Heard the voice of the living God out of the fire
Gone up to the top of the mount
explanation: They asked who of all flesh hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, and lived?

question: What did the LORD say about the words the people spoke to Moses?
choices: They have well said all that they have spoken
explanation: The LORD said, they have well said all that they have spoken.

question: What would the LORD speak to Moses, to be taught to the people?
explanation: Stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments.

question: How many days does the LORD say to labour and do all your work?
explanation: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work.

question: Which of the neighbour's belongings is named first in the commandment against coveting?
explanation: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour's wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour's house.

question: How did the LORD bring Israel out of Egypt, according to the sabbath commandment?
choices: With a pillar of cloud only
With a mighty hand and a stretched out arm
explanation: The LORD thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm.

question: What will happen if Israel walks in all the ways the LORD commanded?
